title: Helicopter chases of about 15 UAP in 60 days; never seen from the air
summary: James Valor tells of Helicopter chases of about 15 UAP in 60 days; never seen from the air, about 2025 at Skywatcher field operations (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Then we sit down in helicopter and we're chasing behind them. I probably pursued about 15 NAYA per the last 60 days.

plain: James Valor, a member of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, says that in 2025 the team would spot objects and then jump into a helicopter to chase them. He says he went after about 15 of them in 60 days, yet, as the story goes, they were never seen from the air. If true, it would mean the objects somehow vanish from view once someone flies close.
